oncall-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: serving-runtime ERROR spike (cuda_timeout) — multiple containers restarting across rack-us-east-3. paging SRE rotation. Please ack and join #incidents if you are oncall.

Tess: acked. I'm oncall, jumping in.

Raj: seeing similar in metrics. GPU OOM and cuda timeout traces correlated with IB retransmit spikes. KV-cache miss rate up.

Tess: quick check — any customer-facing 5xx alerts?

customer-success-amy: several customers reported slow responses and 502 errors around 08:12. CS is collecting affected customer IDs now. No large-scale drop in revenue APM yet but a few enterprise customers opened tickets.

Marcos: logs from runtime show repeated kernel timeouts, then container restart: 
```
[2025-11-08T08:11:42Z] RuntimeError: CUDA kernel timeout on device 0
[2025-11-08T08:11:42Z] Process terminated: exit_code=137
[2025-11-08T08:11:43Z] RDMA: recv_retransmit=240, dup_acks=18, rtt_jitter_ms=120
```

Raj: network counters look noisy on ib0 for nodes in rack 7. If RDMA retransmits spike, NVLink/KV cache coherence suffers and we see token expansion -> OOMs.

Tess: OK, triage plan. 1) isolate bad rack from serving routing 2) drain affected pods 3) fallback to local model variant (no cross-node KV) 4) collect core dumps and attach to ticket.

sre-liz: I'll take 1 and 2. Starting with draining to avoid more restarts.

sre-liz: running: `kubectl -n serve cordon node/gpu-07-rack7 && kubectl -n serve drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data node/gpu-07-rack7`

Marcos: running a fabric probe now: `ibdiag -p 192.168.7.12 --probe=path` result: intermittent timeouts and PMTU mismatch hints.

Raj: can you paste the probe output?

Marcos: `probe: mtu 4096 -> probe failed: ICMP frag needed but DF set`

Tess: that smells like a path-MTU blackhole causing retransmits between racks. That would cause packet loss at the RDMA layer.

customer-success-amy: customers want ETA. Any mitigation yet?

Tess: immediate customer-facing mitigation: routing away from rack, autoscale by spinning up nodes in other racks/regions, and enable CPU-only fallback for a small percent of traffic to reduce OOM risk. CS, tell customers we're routing traffic to healthy capacity; ETA ~20–30m for full recovery.

customer-success-amy: relaying. They asked if there's data loss — we confirmed no persisted data loss, only latency and 502s.

sre-liz: nodes drained, pods rescheduled to gpu-02-rack2 and gpu-04-rack1. Starting canary traffic to verify KV-cache warmup.

Raj: can we enable model-local mode? There's a runtime flag: `--kv-mode=local` on the service config. That will reduce cross-node RDMA dependency. Roll it for 10% traffic first.

Tess: good. Marcos, please help automate config rollout and a canary policy.

Marcos: deploying canary: `redwoodctl rollout --service serve-runtime --set kv_mode=local --percent 10 --duration 5m`

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-20251108-0921. Severity P1 -> Investigating.

Raj: CPU-fallback triggered for 2% traffic as a precaution; latency increases but avoids GPU OOMs.

Tess: monitoring logs to see if cuda_timeout stops.

Marcos: fabric probe to the switch shows egress PMTU enforced to 1500 on intermediate hop; upstream expects 4096 -> fragmentation dropped. Raising a ticket with networking.

sre-liz: reaching out to network oncall @raj-network (ping).

Raj: I'm on network side too — checking switch logs. There's a firmware bug on IB switch model IBX-420 that drops DF-set large packets after a peak flow. We have recent upgrade queued but not applied.

Tess: mitigation options: 1) adjust host PMTU to 1500 (workaround) 2) patch switch (longer) 3) adjust runtime to disable DF for RDMA probes — risky. Which is fastest?

Raj: set host MTU to 1500 on affected nodes, and re-enable RDMA path. It's disruptive (restarts), but we already drained and rescheduled. For remaining nodes on rack7, do it.

sre-liz: applying MTU change to nodes in rack7: `ip link set dev ib0 mtu 1500` then restart rdma service. Will push one node at a time.

Marcos: after MTU change, retransmits dropped from ~240->6 in 2 minutes. CUDA timeouts stopped on nodes that were moved.

Tess: great, start broadening reschedule back to rack7 once stable. Keep canary at 10% for 10 minutes, then ramp.

customer-success-amy: customers notified of mitigation and expected near-term improvements. They asked for RCA when available.

oncall-bot: Update: Severity downgraded to P2 — service restoring.

Tess: followups: 1) schedule switch firmware patch 2) run a controlled PMTU test across racks 3) add RDMA-layer health alarm for sustained retransmit rate 4) add runbook for MTU workaround with steps and customer comm template. Assigning tasks: Raj -> firmware/patch coordination; Marcos -> probe test + alert; Liz -> runbook + postmortem; Tess -> customer comm + RCA draft.

Raj: noted. Opening tracking tickets.

Marcos: collecting pcap/rdma logs and runtime cores, attaching to INC-20251108-0921.

sre-liz: preparing handoff to next oncall in 45m. Current oncall shift will remain until recovery complete.

Tess: thanks everyone. Quick one-line status for PS (post-summaries): "RDMA path-MTU mismatch on IB switch caused packet drops and retransmits, induced GPU kernel timeouts and container restarts. Workaround: host MTU set to 1500 for affected nodes, traffic routed away during mitigation; long-term: firmware patch and runbook." :white_check_mark:

customer-success-amy: sending that to impacted customers now.

oncall-bot: Handoff reminder in 30m.

sre-liz: handing off to night oncall @marcos in 45m unless we see regression.

Marcos: will monitor overnight and follow up with RCA writeup tomorrow.

Tess: closing thread for now — keep incident ticket updated.
